README: This file drives the firmware dropdown in the web flasher.
An entry with an empty url shows up greyed out and cannot be flashed, which is
deliberate: nothing is offered that cannot actually be downloaded.
url    : a direct link to a MERGED firmware image (bootloader + partitions + app
in one file). A GitHub release asset works, as long as it is a single
merged .bin. Build one with: esptool.py --chip esp32 merge_bin -o merged.bin
--flash_mode dio --flash_size 4MB 0x1000 bootloader.bin 0x8000 partitions.bin
0x10000 firmware.bin
offset : where that image starts. A merged image is 0. A bare app image is usually
65536 (0x10000). A typo here is refused rather than treated as 0, because
writing an app image over the bootloader bricks the board.
sha256 : optional but strongly recommended. The SHA-256 of the exact file at url.
When present the browser verifies the download before writing anything, so
a swapped or tampered release asset is refused. Get it with:
sha256sum merged.bin        (Linux/macOS)
certutil -hashfile merged.bin SHA256   (Windows)
Without it the flasher warns in its console that the download is unverified.
Two things to check when you add a URL:
1. The host must send CORS headers. GitHub release assets do. If a download fails
with a CORS error, put the .bin in this repo under assets/firmware/ and use a
relative path like assets/firmware/bruce-esp32.bin instead.
2. Any external host must be listed in connect-src in the CSP, both in the meta tag
in index.html and in _headers.
